name: Loïc David
bio: Loïc is an intern from the French National University of Civil Aviation, where he is a second-year engineer student specialized in IT for air transport. During his internship, he hopes to improve his skills and knowledge in HCI (Human-Computer Interaction) and to discover a new culture.

publications.title: GymSoles: Improving Squats and Dead-Lifts by Visualizing the User’s Centre of Pressure
publications.citation: Elvitigala, D.S., Matthies, D.J., David, L., Weerasinghe, C. and Nanayakkara, S.C., 2019, May. GymSoles: Improving Squats and Dead-Lifts by Visualizing the User's Center of Pressure. In Proceedings of the 2019 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (pp. 1-12).
